Remarks

The wall of tiles is the set of shuffled tiles that are used to play a deal of a match. The wall is made up of 136 tiles for a four-player or two-player game, and 108 tiles for a three-player game (due to dropping the 2-8 of the Man suit).

When created, a wall is already "broken", which means that the point where tiles will be dealt to players and then drawn from has been decided, as the "live" wall. Breaking the wall also marks the "dead" wall, which is made up of 14 tiles in a four-player or two-player game, and 20 tiles in a three-player game. The dead wall is used for drawing replacement tiles for kan calls (and kita calls in three-player games), as well as tracking dora indicators. One dora indicator is revealed when the wall is created. More dora indicators are revealed each time a kan is made. Each indicator indicates a dora tile that receives the dora bonus of one han per tile during scoring.

Constructors

Wall(IRandomNumberGenerator, PlayerCount, bool, int)

Constructor. Takes in an IRandomNumberGenerator, a PlayerCount, whether or not to use red fives, and optionally a dice roll to use to break the wall (for testing purposes).

public Wall(IRandomNumberGenerator rng, PlayerCount playerCount, bool hasRedFives, int breakDiceRoll = -1)

Parameters

rng IRandomNumberGenerator

The IRandomNumberGenerator to use for random numbers.

playerCount PlayerCount

The number of players in the match as a PlayerCount.

hasRedFives bool

Whether or not red fives should be used.

breakDiceRoll int

If specified (set to something besides -1), will be used as the roll to break the wall instead of getting a dice roll from rng. Parameter only meant for testing purposes.

Remarks

Once created, the wall will already be "broken" based on either a dice roll from rng, or a roll provided by breakDiceRoll, ready to deal tiles. Note that rng will be used for shuffling the wall regardless of the value of breakDiceRoll.
